help.title: Help & Support
help.desc: Step-by-step guidance on booking, medical records, and live chamber queue.
help.step1Desc: Search by doctor or specialty, choose a time slot, and confirm in 3 simple steps.
help.step2Desc: Access your digital medicine list, dosage instructions, and lab reports from any device.
help.step3Desc: Check your serial and estimated consultation time live to avoid hospital waiting.
help.faq1Q: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
help.faq1A: Yes. Open Appointments, select your visit, and click 'Reschedule' or 'Cancel appointment'.
help.faq2Q: Who can see my uploaded medical records?
help.faq2A: By default, only you. When marked 'Doctor Access', your attending physician can review them during active visits.
help.faq3Q: How do I print my prescription?
help.faq3A: Open the prescription from your records and click 'Print Preview' for a clean A4/A5 clinical document.
